title: backlog store
description: The /backlog skill's store — one JSON file per dest (<dest>/backlog.json), the sole format. Active items live in sections (epics, Icebox); done and rejected rows in archive; every board, skill or routine-runner write appends a changelog row. active and next id are derived (count of items; highest id across sections and archive plus one).

added.description: date the item entered the store

deps.description: item ids this item waits on

description.description: the dump's own lines for this item, verbatim and trimmed, then one 'Done when:' line; merges append later dump text under a date prefix; never title-only

evidence.description: pointers named in the dump or the conversation — commits, files, sessions, docs; machine writers put 'commit <sha>' first, then bare session ids; a session pointer is the id or 'session <8+ hex prefix>', optionally '#<finding index>' to name one finding of its record

link.description: plan dir, PR, or the dispatched run's dated branch the routine runner writes; empty until then

mined.description: set when the smine nightly mined this item from session records: the session of the run that mined it, the mining date and the session ids it came from

by.description: session id of the run that mined the row; absent on rows mined before it was recorded

route.description: /idea | /concept | /fexplore | /fdesign | /skillroutine-create | direct | experiment, with args (e.g. '/fdesign','/skillroutine-create skill'); empty for track-only items

title.description: the user's own wording, trimmed, at most 120 runes

commit.description: set on a proposal rejected on the Proposals page: its change commit; the reason is the user's

reason.description: resolution on done rows, rejection reason on rejected rows

name.description: an epic name, unique in the store, or 'Icebox'
